author: kiawwa
body:
Okay, so apparently this is my leaving post. I’ve told most of my really good friends goodbye, but I’m going to tell everyone else now. Uhmm… Goodbye!
But yeah, Avicus was a big “adventure” in my life. I’m definitely going to remember my 3 years on Avi. (I think it’s been 3 years with my older accounts.. maybe?) I definitely have met a lot of amazing people, thoughtful people, and also mean people. But overall I’m so happy that I started playing on this server, and I’m so happy that I met the people that I did. It’s very hard for me to leave this wonderful community, and all the beautiful people, but I think it’s better for me and I hope no one hates me for my decision..
I just wanted to say thanks to DoctaPop, HershyGirl, Ingigo, Lavish, StormzInvader, SilverFoxYT, pxblocz, Cyclops, MerlinMaster, GalaxyBrit, GrapeSmoothie, Smiley, Marinis, MLGPorky, Zeusy, MasterProX, Kacers, and last.. but most important and very lovely, Emmylou.
Also, I might come back in a few months, but probably not.
OkiOki I’m done now, bye everyone. I love you all and I hope you do well in the future c:
